visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Headings written as data cells
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A screen reader reads this table's column names like ordinary data, so nobody can tell which number is the price. The first row must use heading cells.

solution.explanation: th marks a cell as a heading for its column or row. Browsers make it bold and centred, and screen readers announce it with every value below it. A td is plain data.

checks.label: The first row has heading cells
Item and Price are the headings
